faq_heading: Homes near North Ridge Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the North Ridge Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the North Ridge Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names North Ridge Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to North Ridge Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are iLearn Secondary School Society (0.3 km east), Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (0.6 km north-west) and Henry Bose Elementary (0.7 km north).

North Ridge Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 13460 62 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions North Ridge Elementary.
How the North Ridge Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names North Ridge Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. Ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of North Ridge Elementary

25 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of North Ridge Elementary in a straight line (19 elementary, 5 secondary, 1 other; 5 independent). The closest is iLearn Secondary School Society, 0.3 km away, and the farthest on this list is Dr F D Sinclair Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Henry Bose Elementary (0.7 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (0.6 km). Other elementary schools close by: Henry Bose Elementary (0.7 km north), St Bernadette (1.0 km north-west), Panorama Park Elementary (1.2 km west), Hyland Elementary (1.4 km north-east), Martha Jane Norris Elementary (1.5 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Henry Bose Elementary, 0.7 km north of North Ridge Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near North Ridge Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from North Ridge Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Go past North Ridge Elementary on a school morning and again mid-afternoon to see the traffic, parking and noise before you offer.
Look at Henry Bose Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.7 km north of North Ridge Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
